cues: Now put an unknown resistance X between the leads.
The current falls to E over G plus R plus X. Watch the needle as X grows: it moves left, slowly at first and then crowding up.
So the scale is reversed, with zero on the right and infinity on the left, and it is non uniform, cramped at large X.
